name: lsc-tig-awards tig_2018_archive
description: The amounts LSC's three documents for the 2018 TIG round printed in 2018 and 2019, read from the Internet Archive's earliest captures of their old lsc.gov addresses: the full release (captured 25 December 2018), the per-grantee release (8 December 2018) and the description page (12 June 2019). Each amount is matched to LSC's TIG number by grantee and project description and read from the raw text of the capture. Compiled by MV2 of Munim, Inc. with AI agents working in his name. CC BY 4.0.

fields.captures[].source: which LSC document, as in data/tig_history.json: page, release or bundle (the per-grantee release)
fields.captures[].original: the document's lsc.gov address at the time of the capture
fields.captures[].dated: date the document prints, where it prints one
fields.captures[].quote: the document's statement of the round, quoted from the capture
fields.captures[].since_2000: the document's running total for the TIG program, quoted from the capture; null where it prints none
fields.captures[].amounts: amount as printed in the capture, by TIG number; only grants the capture prints an amount for
